items.label: Elegant Rose Gold Design — Modern, Clean & Stylish
items.value: A soft Rose Gold finish adds a modern and elegant look to your workspace, making it ideal for students, young professionals, and anyone who prefers a clean and aesthetic setup

items.label: Lightweight & Portable — Easy to Carry for School or Travel
items.value: Slim and lightweight design fits easily into backpacks, making it perfect for school, commuting, library study sessions, travel, and everyday use.

items.label: 4GB Memory
items.value: Equipped with 4GB memory to deliver stable, energy-efficient performance for everyday tasks such as web browsing, online learning, document editing, and video calls.

items.label: 64GB SSD Storage
items.value: Built-in 64GB SSD provides faster system startup and quick access to applications and files, offering practical local storage for daily work, school, and home use while pairing well with cloud storage options.

items.label: Windows 11 with Copilot AI
items.value: Preloaded with Windows 11 and Copilot AI to help with research, summaries, and everyday productivity

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Memory Card Slot, Spill Resistant

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories with USB, HDMI, USB-C, or wireless connectivity options.
